<div class="site-shell">
<div class="section-intro compact-intro">
<div>
<h2 id="software-projects-title">Research software and replications</h2>
</div>
<p class="intro-copy">These public repositories include original research tools, reproducible data pipelines, replications, and portfolio demonstrations. Their descriptions distinguish those roles explicitly.</p>
</div>

<div class="work-grid research-output-grid">
<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Open-source research tool</span>
<h3>AI qualitative interviews</h3>
<p>An open-source, Qualtrics-integrated application for structured long-form qualitative data collection using language models. It supports configurable interviews and validation; research protocols, consent, data protection, and human oversight remain the responsibility of the research team.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/ai-qualitative-interviews">View repository</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Research data pipeline</span>
<h3>Newspaper labour extraction</h3>
<p>Reproducible Python and SLURM pipelines for processing OCR-derived historical job advertisements, extracting structured information, and running large batched jobs.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/newslabor-extract">View repository</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Simulation framework</span>
<h3>LLM Experimental Economics Simulation</h3>
<p>A code-only framework that reconstructs an experimental-economics design from public materials and evaluates heuristic or LLM agents against empirical targets. It documents leakage safeguards and reproducible simulation audits; results are not yet presented as empirical findings.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/llm-experimental-economics-simulation">View repository</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Replication</span>
<h3>Colombia education CCT replication</h3>
<p>A reproducible R baseline replication of treatment effects from Barrera-Osorio et al.’s Colombian conditional cash-transfer experiment, using the authors’ official replication package.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/colombia-education-cct-replication">View repository</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Portfolio demonstration</span>
<h3>Basel transit investment analysis</h3>
<p>A reproducible spatial-analysis project combining Swiss GTFS and Basel-Stadt open data with a locally authorised business-location input. Its grant and investment scenario is fictional: it demonstrates geocoding, spatial joins, transit-access metrics, validation, and map/report outputs, not an evaluation or policy recommendation.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/basel-transit-investment-analysis">View repository</a></div>
</article>

<article class="work-card">
<span class="status-tag">Synthetic-data reference implementation</span>
<h3>Constrained slate recommender</h3>
<p>An independent reference implementation of a constrained recommender. It grew out of earlier work at ConsiliumBots on <em>Decidiendo para un Futuro Mejor</em>, conducted with J-PAL LAC; it contains no partner data, code, or configuration and is not a release of that system.</p>
<div class="work-links"><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/mkmacho/constrained-slate-recommender">View repository</a></div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
